definitions.full: H8535. tam תָּם adjective complete — ׳ת Gen 25:27 10 t.; suffix תַּמָּתִי Song 5:2 ; 6:9 (late, except Gen 25:27 ); — 1 complete, perfect: in beauty Song 5:2 ; 6:9 ; of physical strength Psa 73:4 (read תָּם לָ֑מוֺ Ew De Dr Sam. xxxi Che Bae and others). 2 sound, wholesome: תָּם אישׁ , of Jacob as tent-dweller, opposed to Esau, hunter, Gen 25:27 (J; De leutseliger Mann , Di ruhig, still , AV RV plain man ; ׳ת here possibly redactional, = 3 ). 3 complete, morally innocent, having integrity: תָּם אִישׁ Job 1:8 ; 2:3 ; ׳ת alone 1:1 ; 8:20 ; 9:20-21 , 22 ; Prov 29:10 ; Psa 37:37 ; 64:5 . — תַּמִּים see [ תָּאם ]. p. 1060f
